document-lockup.purpose: Masthead wordmark, set in the document serif to declare the surface as a document.

document-body.purpose: Clause lead-in and flagged sentence text — the contract's own words.

quote.purpose: Exact quoted clause inside a comment balloon, colored to severity.

chrome-body.purpose: Redline's own voice: tagline, advisory note, confirmation text.

chrome-label.purpose: Uppercase severity tag chip inside a comment balloon.

motion.name: bar-grow
motion.purpose: Margin change-bar grows from the top, staggered per clause, severity-ordered (Severe before High).

motion.name: flag-in
motion.purpose: The flagged sentence recolors from neutral ink to its severity color as it is marked up.

motion.name: balloon-in
motion.purpose: Comment balloon slides in from the document edge, carrying the quoted clause.

motion.name: stagger-step
motion.value: 0.4s per clause index, plus a 0.15s/0.45s/0.65s internal offset for bar/flag/balloon
motion.purpose: Severity-ordered entrance: the most severe clause redlines itself first.

components.name: Primary Button (CTA)
components.description: The page's single call to action, 'Try it on a document' — plain, high-contrast, no gradient or glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #fffdf9; background: #1c1a16; border: none; border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.85rem 1.85rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #b3261e; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d5fd6; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #58544a; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button (reset link)
components.description: Text-only reset action ('Choose a different file'), underlined, no fill or border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: none; border: none; padding: 0; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1c1a16; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #b3261e; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d5fd6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Comment Balloon — Severe
components.description: The signature annotation component: severity tag, exact quoted clause, and advisory note, pinned beside the flagged sentence.
components.html:
Severe

“all right, title, and interest therein shall vest exclusively in Client immediately upon creation, regardless of the payment status of any invoice issued hereunder.”

This clause assigns your pre-existing tools and materials too, and the rights transfer the moment you create the work — before you've been paid. Ask for assignment on payment, and a carve-out for what you already owned.
components.css: .ds-balloon { background: #fbeae9; border: 1px solid #b3261e; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; position: relative; } .ds-balloon-tag { display: inline-block; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #fffdf9; background: #b3261e; padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-balloon-quote { font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.45; color: #b3261e; margin-top: 0.6rem; } .ds-balloon-text { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.92rem; line-height: 1.5; color: #1c1a16; margin-top: 0.5rem; }

components.name: Comment Balloon — High
components.description: Same balloon structure as Severe, recolored to the High severity tier (Redline Amber) — the decided second flag color.
components.html:
High

“Client's sole discretion to approve, following delivery of the Work Product.”

Payment is gated behind an open-ended approval step before the 90-day clock even starts. Ask for a fixed due date measured from delivery, not from approval.
components.css: .ds-balloon--high { background: #fbf0e2; border: 1px solid #9c5a12; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; } .ds-balloon--high .ds-balloon-tag { background: #9c5a12; color: #fffdf9; } .ds-balloon--high .ds-balloon-quote { font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; color: #9c5a12; margin-top: 0.6rem; } .ds-balloon--high .ds-balloon-text { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1c1a16; margin-top: 0.5rem; }

components.name: Margin Change-Bar
components.description: The 4px severity-colored vertical mark beside a flagged sentence; grows from scaleY(0) on entrance.
components.html: all right, title, and interest therein shall vest exclusively in Client immediately upon creation...
components.css: .ds-flagged-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 4px 1fr; column-gap: 0.85rem; } .ds-bar { border-radius: 2px; background: #b3261e; transform-origin: top; } .ds-flagged-text { font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.7; color: #b3261e; text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Masthead / Navigation
components.description: Sticky top bar carrying only the wordmark, set in the document serif, no nav links.
components.css: .ds-masthead { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10; background: #fffdf9; border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd8cc; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; } .ds-wordmark { font-family: 'Source Serif 4', serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.1rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #1c1a16; }

narrative.overview: Redline's first surface is named after what it is: a Word/Google Docs track-changes markup — the industry term for a redlined contract comparison. There is no dashboard, no card grid, no "AI analysis panel." The contract itself, rendered faithfully, is the interface: a margin change-bar, an underlined flagged sentence, and a comment balloon pinned by a leader line to the exact clause it concerns. The system exists to make one thing checkable at a glance — this points at my actual sentence — because wrong citations are the product's stated #1 trust problem to solve (PRODUCT.md, ADR 0001). The world is quiet on purpose. The one accent that's allowed to be loud is the flag itself; everything else — masthead, button, tagline — sits in restrained system-ui gray-on-cream so it never competes with the document being marked up. Confirmed rejection: no dashboard/verdict-card arrangement, no gradient or glow on the call-to-action, no card chrome wrapping the document (an explicit finish-review fix — body, masthead, and document now share one background rather than sitting in a boxed container).
keyCharacteristics: Document-as-interface: no card wrapping the contract; the page background is the document's background.
One loud color family per severity tier, everywhere else restrained gray/cream.
Staggered, severity-ordered reveal: the redline marks itself in front of you.
A workmanlike document serif for contract text, quiet system-ui for everything that isn't the document.

rules.name: The One Accent Per Tier Rule
rules.body: A clause's margin bar, underlined sentence quote-in-balloon, and balloon border/tag all read in the same severity color (--sev-color), switched by a single data-severity attribute. No clause ever mixes tier colors within itself.

rules.name: The One Document Face Rule
rules.body: Any text that is the contract's own words is set in Source Serif 4. Any text that is Redline's own voice is set in system-ui. No third face, no display face.

rules.name: The No-Card Rule
rules.body: The document, masthead, and page body all share the same --page background with no bounding box, border, or shadow separating them — a finish-review correction to an earlier boxed-container treatment. Only the comment balloon and the after-select confirmation panel get a bounded surface.

dos: Do carry every severity tier in a single color pair (fill + tint), keyed off data-severity, never a one-off inline color.
Do set contract-text content (clause numbers, lead-in, flagged sentence, quoted excerpt) in the document serif; set Redline's own voice (labels, buttons, advisory notes) in system-ui.
Do let the document and its chrome share one background; a bounded box is reserved for an annotation (balloon) or a status panel (after-select), never for the document itself.
Do keep the CTA plain and high-contrast — ink fill, no gradient, no glow — per the direction contract's explicit instruction, with the alarm-red hover as the only departure.
donts: Don't introduce a third severity color, a dashboard/verdict-card layout, or a boxed document container — all three are confirmed rejections of this surface's own direction contract and finish review.
Don't apply a drop shadow or elevation lift anywhere; this system conveys grouping with hairline rules and tint/border fills only.

Don't treat --confirm (green) or --focus (blue) as decorative — green is reserved for the not-yet-built "confirmed present protection" state (ADR 0006) and blue is the live focus ring; neither is a free-choice accent color.
Don't set UI chrome (labels, buttons, nav) in the document serif, and don't set contract text in system-ui — the pairing's whole job is to keep the two registers visually distinct.
